column3: Being judged is rendered as “when You judge,” reversing the role.
“On us” specifies the recipients of wrath.
“Why not say” supplies a verb to the opening elliptical question.
The singular throat and grave are pluralized; under the lips is rendered as “on their lips.”
“In their wake” renders in their paths.
“He did this” supplies the opening clause.
Circumcision and uncircumcision are rendered as circumcised and uncircumcised people; “same” is supplied.
